item.title: I love R
item.description: A little bit of context i currently work as a Head of Analytics at a "reputable" company and i am so bored with my current leadership role in analytics, i am so dependent on it because it pays well but i would love to become an individual contributor again and get to work with R everyday. Do you happen to have any tips for me? And can i actually quit and make a living by being an R developer.
